coverage_note: Monterey–Point Sur limited preview: nine bounded CDFW MPA polygons, scoped Central rules, local NWS marine zones and Monterey tide predictions. Northern-reference buoys and 6 km surface radar are not Point Sur or bottom observations; chlorophyll populated only 4 of 190 requested cells in the first rehearsal. Original Offshore Monterey grids overlap only the northern edge and lack reviewed chart-datum depth uncertainty. No qualified fishing marks, drifts or exports.
landing_note: Point Sur is exposed and this package has no verified fishing positions. Check exact MPAs and current conditions before planning a trip.
